nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Restricts the Docker build context (repo root on Railway) to only the broker module, excluding the Tauri app, node_modules, and Rust target dirs to keep image uploads small.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an ignore-all-then-allowlist pattern (`*` followed by `!broker`) so only the broker directory reaches the Docker daemon.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn-svelte configuration defining Tailwind CSS entry, base color, style preset, icon library, and path aliases ($lib/components, $lib/utils, etc.) used when generating UI components.

nodes.name: mise.toml
nodes.summary: mise dev-toolchain and task-runner config pinning tool versions (node, java, rust, go, cocoapods) and defining the full dev/build/test workflow — Tauri desktop/Android/iOS dev, emulator control, the Go broker, linting, bindings generation, and the offline test gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Tera templating (`{% if %}`) in the env block to switch FLOPPY_BROKER_URL between the local and remote broker.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the SvelteKit + TypeScript frontend, declaring Tauri API/plugin dependencies, the Svelte/Tailwind/shadcn dev toolchain, and scripts for Vite dev/build, svelte-check, Tauri, linting, and formatting.

nodes.name: railway.json
nodes.summary: Railway deployment configuration that builds the service from broker/Dockerfile and applies an on-failure restart policy with up to 10 retries.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration extending the generated SvelteKit tsconfig, enabling strict type-checking, JS checking, bundler module resolution, and source maps for the frontend.
